notes: GREEK DEFENDER VERTICAL SLICE. First unit on the new character architecture (src/render/greek-defender.js): Character Bible proportions (7.5 heads, arms 3.5, legs 3.5) replacing the legacy 6.36-head/1.91-head-arm build; one item per hand with the shield on the OUTSIDE arm and the weapon on the INSIDE arm; true side-view occlusion by draw order over solid fills; anatomical joint limits (elbows flex forward only, knees backward only). Every clip passed geometry-clearance, rendered-pixel, anatomy and grip-continuity validation at frame and half-frame resolution - zero impossible frames, verified against the runtime module itself and not only the authoring tool. The dory leaves the hand on the exact release frame and a dying soldier drops it. Only the spear class uses the new renderer; every other unit keeps the existing rig, and any error falls back to it. Disable with ?legacyrig=1. No save schema change.
